questions.question: The .NET SDK and Node.js aren't installed on this machine. How should I proceed?

options.label: Install both via winget (Recommended)
options.description: Run winget to install .NET 10 SDK and Node.js 22 LTS, then build the full foundation with real verification.

options.label: Build files only, verify later
options.description: I hand-write all project files (solution, csproj, npm manifests, docs, CI) without running any build. You verify once you install the tools.

options.label: Try Docker-only verification
options.description: Skip local SDK installs; validate builds inside Docker containers instead (requires Docker Desktop running).
